source: Current independent TF2 and Classified menu pages and feature registries. Edition-specific controls are labeled; entries describe the preview source, not complete gameplay acceptance.

items.label: Aimbot
items.desc: Enable this aim profile.

items.desc: Show the selected aim angle as an overlay.
